# SHA-256 of the committed golden corpora, and of the Go oracle programs that
# produced them. The oracle is not part of this crate; it lives beside it in
# ../color-parity-oracle/, because a Rust migration that still ships Go source
# has not finished migrating.
#
# This file ties the two together. It lets a third party confirm that the corpus
# in this repository is the output of that recorded oracle, without having to
# trust either. See the Verification section of README.md for the exact commands.
#
